testimonials.quote: My daughter used to miss school to help at home. With her books and uniform covered, she hasn't missed a single day this year.
testimonials.name: Asha Verma

testimonials.quote: Every quarter I get an update showing exactly what my gift paid for. That openness is why I've kept giving for six years.
testimonials.name: Daniel Brooks

testimonials.quote: I came for one Saturday. Two years later I lead the kitchen team. Watching the children eat together is the best part of my week.
testimonials.name: Priya Nair

testimonials.quote: Many of these children had never seen a doctor. One check-up and a vaccine can change their whole year.
testimonials.name: Dr. Rahul Mehta
